title: Check for dereferences of fixed addresses.
summary: It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.core.FixedAddressDereference. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.

title: Check that NSLocalizedString macros include a comment for context.
summary: It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.osx.cocoa.localizability.EmptyLocalizationContextChecker. It applies to Objective-C.

title: Warns about uses of non-localized NSStrings passed to UI methods expecting localized NSStrings.
summary: It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.osx.cocoa.localizability.NonLocalizedStringChecker. It applies to Objective-C.

title: Check for excessively padded structs.
summary: It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.performance.Padding. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.

title: This checker warns when the denominator in a division operation is a tainted (potentially attacker controlled) value.
summary: If the attacker can set the denominator to 0, a runtime error can be triggered. The checker warns when the denominator is a tainted value and the analyzer cannot prove that it is not 0. It is an opt-in checker, so the analyzer runs it only when you enable it. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-optin.taint.TaintedDiv. It applies to C, C++, Objective-C.
